name: ASM-005 pulley tensioner assembly benchmark
description: Intermediate hierarchical CAD assembly benchmark for a belt pulley tensioner with bracket, pivot arm, pulley wheel, axle, spacers, and adjustment screw.

tasks.prompt: Create a belt pulley tensioner assembly with a fixed bracket, pivot arm, pulley wheel, axle pin, spacer bushings, and adjustment screw. Keep components simple, robust, and visually recognizable.
assumptions: Intermediate assembly benchmark intended to exercise hierarchy, named modules, and repeated functional components without BRIEF-001 full-vehicle complexity.
Robust simple boxes, cylinders, and compounds are preferred over fragile booleans or detailed decorative hardware.
Generated STEP, GLB, topology, and component artifacts are produced by the CAD pipeline and are not hand-edited source of truth.
